Build an optional translation provider.

Source: R/curation_translation.R
curation_translation_provider.Rd

The provider is a dependency-injected boundary around a translation worker. It has no default engine and does not read options or environment variables. A serialized write gate is required before translated values are written to a shared cache or sidecar, so a deployment can coordinate one record at a time.

Usage

curation_translation_provider(
  translate_fn,
  service_id,
  source_language_fn = NULL,
  cache_read_fn = NULL,
  cache_write_fn = NULL,
  write_gate_fn = NULL,
  write_policy = c("disabled", "serialized")
)

Arguments

translate_fn

Function accepting record, source_language, and target_language, returning a named list with translated fields such as title_en and summary_en.

service_id

Stable backend/version identifier recorded with results.

source_language_fn

Optional function accepting record and returning a source-language code.

cache_read_fn

Optional function accepting key and service_id and returning a previously translated result, or NULL on a miss. The key contains country, document_id, and target_language.

cache_write_fn

Optional function accepting the same target-qualified key and a value.

write_gate_fn

Function accepting the record key and write_fn; it must invoke write_fn while holding the deployment's per-record serialized gate. The gate key excludes target_language, so two target writes for one record cannot overlap.

write_policy

Either "disabled" or "serialized".

Value

A planscanR_curation_translation_provider object.
